title: Handcart Companies
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: See “Full Company List,” Mormon Pioneer Overland Travel database,history.ChurchofJesusChrist.org. See Topics:Emigration,Pioneer Trek.

The well-known tradition of three young rescuers carrying an entire company across the Sweetwater River, dying from the effects of the rescue, and being promised eternal life on the basis of that single act, appears to have been embellished. See Chad M. Orton, “The Martin Handcart Company at the Sweetwater: Another Look,”BYU Studies,vol. 45, no. 3 (2006), 5–37.
